Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines · Time, the calendar & feasts

holidays noun

also holiday, vacation, feasts, at the end of the vacation, spend the holidays, spring break, spring holidays, Easter holidays, today is a holiday

classical

fēriae, fēriārum f. pl.

noun, first declension, plural

holidays, vacation

Other words

  • vacātiō, vacātiōnis f.

    noun, third declension · also used · modern · Traupman 52–54, 401; M-O s.v. tourist: vacation

Examples

  • Crās fēriae incipiunt!

    The holidays start tomorrow!composed

  • fēriīs perāctīs

    at the end of the holidaysTraupman 54

  • fēriās agere

    spend the holidaysTraupman 54

  • fēriae vernae

    the spring breakTraupman 384

  • fēriās vernās agere

    to spend the spring breakTraupman 384

  • Hodiē fēriās agimus.

    Today is a holiday.Traupman 328

See also summer holidays, day off, be on holiday, birthday.
